src='''def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(grid[r])]
    if not rows: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r1=max(rows)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        s=r1-r
        for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if v and 0<=c-s<W:
                out[r][c-s]=v
    return out
'''
